Getting started

One clean lap is a good first goal.

  1. STEERFind a comfortable neutral
  2. DRIVELearn the pad
  3. FINISHRace your first rival

Your first lap

Open TURN, start TURN TUTORIAL and drive COUNTRYSIDE in the LEARNER CAR. Each lesson pauses to explain one action; hold its highlighted control to continue. Optional tutorial steering help lets you concentrate on the drive pad.

Your next lap

Crossing the line hands over to ordinary racing, with the tutorial lap as a rival. Aim for a smoother lap before a faster car.

Choose your way in

Use device rotation, on-screen steering or keyboard controls. For non-visual play, combine a screen reader with DRIVE BY EAR and its dedicated tutorial.

Keep exploring

ROADBOOK holds tracks and records. GARAGE holds cars, paint and setups. Achievements earn trophies; Trophy Road unlocks more possibilities.
